_about: Each day Mon to Sat has one Skill task and one Reach task, about 30 minutes each: tonight's hour. Either can be done first. Sunday is the weekly review. Practice is on new real work. Every task is worth 20 points; points are a simple count of work done, not a grade. Trust comes from the evidence source, not the points.
focus: Run a first usability test and get your CV into shape.

tasks.task: Write 3 questions for a usability test
tasks.why: You will use them with a real person this week.
tasks.example:
1. Show me how you would pay for this.
2. What would you expect to happen next?
Who I could ask: a friend who shops online.
tasks.exampleWhy: Each question gets the tester to do something instead of giving an opinion.

tasks.task: Read your CV and fix what is wrong
tasks.why: It is the first thing a recruiter sees.
steps: Add anything missing you are proud of
tasks.example: Changed "worked on the checkout" to "redesigned the checkout flow as the only designer".
tasks.exampleWhy: Each change names what you did and how big it was.
